_note: AuthZEN 1.0 section 9 (PDP metadata). 9.2 and 9.2.1: the document is served at GET /.well-known/authzen-configuration; 9.2.2: 200 with Content-Type application/json. 9.1.1: policy_decision_point and access_evaluation_endpoint (REQUIRED), access_evaluations_endpoint and search_action_endpoint; search_subject_endpoint and search_resource_endpoint are absent because Attenuo does not serve those Search APIs (an absent parameter means the PDP does not support that API), capabilities (9.1.2) is absent because no registered capability applies, and signed_metadata (9.1.3) is not published. The exact comparison also proves nothing else is in the document. The document is public metadata: step 0 sends no credential, and step 1 sends a credential that is not a valid token and still gets the same document, because discovery does not look at Authorization.
